findings.finding: The current findSentenceFocus implementation returns null for these four sampled examples on Node 26.11.1 / ICU 78.3. Three targets are inflected; それ is grouped with なら by the segmenter. These valid sentences need explicit focus to enter Cloze.
findings.validation: All four suggested spans occur once and match the specified offsets. Offsets here are identical in Unicode code points and UTF-16 because the prefixes contain only BMP characters.

findings.finding: The sentence correctly uses せめて as at least / the minimum hoped for. The inherited English Even in the worst case and Korean 가장 나쁜 경우라고 하더라도 do not teach that minimum-request sense. All four extra sentence translations and meaningDe already express the correct sense.

suggestedCorrection.meaningEn: at least; expressing the minimum one hopes for or asks for

meanings.fr: au moins ; le minimum que l’on espère ou demande
meanings.zh: 至少；起码；表示希望或要求的最低限度

suggestedCorrection.reason: Align the inherited definition with the minimum-request sense of せめて used naturally in the authored example.

findings.finding: The English gloss requires a twig to have broken off, while the Korean definition and the perched-bird sentence describe a branch growing from the plant. Being detached is not part of this sense of 枝.

suggestedCorrection.meaningKo: 가지; 식물의 큰 줄기나 굵은 가지에서 뻗어 나온 줄기

meanings.es: rama; tallo que sale del tronco o de otra rama
meanings.fr: branche ; rameau issu du tronc ou d’une autre branche
meanings.zh: 树枝；从主干或较大枝条长出的部分

suggestedCorrection.reason: Remove the incorrect broken-off requirement from the inherited English gloss; retain the attached-branch usage in the example.

findings.finding: The example One plus one makes two directly restates the entry definition The number that is the sum of one and one. It is grammatically correct but falls short of the authoring requirement to supply a contextual example rather than paraphrase the definition.

suggestedExamplePatch.text: 番号札に「二」と書かれていました。

findings.note: This is a content-quality finding, not a claim that the original arithmetic or Japanese grammar is wrong.

suggestions.finding: The target 中 is embedded in 中ほど. The segmenter still offers 中 as a Cloze answer, but this is less transparent for a beginner than an independent noun use. The phrasing about the middle of two chairs is also less direct than the ordinary 間 expression.

suggestedExamplePatch.text: 箱の中に小さな時計があります。
suggestedExamplePatch.en: There is a small clock inside the box.

requiredCompanionSenseUpdate.meaningEn: the inside or interior of something

suggestions.note: Optional clarity rewrite. If adopted, update the selected sense alongside the sentence rather than silently switching a between/middle gloss to an inside example.

suggestions.finding: Korean 설 can suggest Lunar New Year, while the Japanese 正月 and other translations leave the statement as New Year. A calendar-neutral 새해 avoids an unnecessary cultural assumption.

suggestedExamplePatch.ko: 새해에 온 집안 식구가 할아버지 댁에 모였어요.

suggestions.note: This is an ambiguity-reduction suggestion, not a claim that 설 can never translate 正月.

limits: This is an AI editorial sample review, not native-speaker review or certification.
Only 120 of 1,977 authored examples received linguistic review. No error-rate estimate for the full population is claimed.
Only the three correction rows attached to sampled example IDs received linguistic review; the other correction rows were checked structurally only.
Additional-language sentence translations were reviewed only for the 52 sampled rows that supplied them. Missing pairs were not invented or treated as complete.
All 1,977 example rows and 71 correction rows passed the repository validators and uniqueness checks; these checks establish structure, not language quality.
The two pronunciation repairs were checked against dictionary sources. No claim is made that every sampled reading was independently dictionary-verified.
No recorded issue means none was identified in this pass, not that a row is proven error-free.
The existing 1,234 rows without all additional translations remain a separate known backfill requirement.
